summary: frontend aggregationUtils counted premi_pph as gross premi; fixed because premi_pph belongs to net-pay addition.
frontend aggregationUtils counted pot_koreksi in net deductions; fixed to avoid double-deducting koreksi after it already reduces jumlah_upah_kotor.
frontend aggregationUtils summed signed negative deductions directly; fixed by summing deduction magnitudes.
employeePayrollBreakdown hid negative-source koreksi/potongan due amount > 0 checks; fixed with absolute deduction magnitude handling.
employeePayrollBreakdown could fall back to ASTEK jumlah as worker deduction; fixed to prefer worker-only fields and avoid majikan/jumlah generic deductions.
PayrollAggregator active-employee filter used hari_kerja/kehadiran while backend totals use jumlah_hk; fixed to align frontend flattening with backend totals.
Focused backend and frontend suites plus frontend build pass; Vite still reports existing summaryReportService mixed import chunking warning.
PayslipCard and exportPayslipsToExcel could use ASTEK total/majikan as worker deduction; fixed to prefer pot_astek_pekerja and not fall back to pot_astek_jumlah.
PayslipCard and exportPayslipsToExcel cancelled premi_pph by adding it twice in total potongan math; fixed so premi_pph is a net-pay credit once.
exportPayslipsToExcel referenced footerRow before declaration in renderPayslipCard, which could fail at runtime; fixed by declaring footerRow before use.
EmployeeDetailPage and SalaryHistoryTable hid negative-source koreksi/potongan and included premi_pph in gross premium details; fixed with deduction magnitudes and gross-premi exclusions.
